title: Machine and Static
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Freya Ashgrove, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
